lede: Wat Phra Chao Lan Thong accounts for 4 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Chiang Rai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1931–1967 CE (3 of 4 carry a date).
